notes.title: 1.1.2 - TRIGGER FIRE and BUG FIXES
notes.notes:
The desert scenery is really amazing!

We managed to optimize it even more and we are creating a very nice list of missions for you!
The machine gun is also ready and we are finishing everything to publish next week!

Some of you asked and we put the trigger on the VR joystick to shoot flares and also, in the future, the machine gun.
If you use GAMEPAD or HOTAS the trigger is already configured as default, but you can also configure the trigger on the control configuration screen.

We fixed some bugs, including the grab bug that some of you identified. Thanks for that by the way!

Hope you guys are enjoying it! 
Have a nice week!

notes.title: 1.0.8 - UPDATE TREES AND FORESTS
notes.notes:
1.0.8 - UPDATE TREES AND FORESTS

Hi guys! Running to add more and more content for you!

in this week's update, we focus on performance to add trees to the scenery!

In the menu to select between NONE, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH and ULTRA.

In our tests, the medium configuration worked on ALL computers. 
With minimum GEFORCE GTX 970 video card. On modern computers, select ULTRA and no FPS loss!

Enjoy even more the landscape of this incredible scenery, now with more nature and life!

notes.title: 1.0.7 UPDATE: Train and Live Scenario!
notes.notes:
Continuing our updates, in this week's 1.0.7 update, we added a train! Along with a special mission to transport a person to a station!

Much is yet to come, especially in missions.

We optimized our game this week to "free up" some space and add lots of items! Like trees, birds, wild animals, and vehicles!

In the coming weeks, we can expect many more missions! But for now, have fun following the train and enjoying every moment of our HELICOPTER SIMULATOR VR 2021.

Summarising, that's what we did this week:

1.0.7
- Tracks and the Train
- Two train stations
- Mission to transport VIP to a train station
- Performance and minor bug fixes.

1.0.6
- cockpit reflection with a control from 0 to 100%, so you can choose the reflection that suits you.

1.0.5
- Now you can lock your hand on the joystick. So there is no need to hold a grab on the VR controller.
To do this, open the in-game menu and choose "Lock Joystick on Grab"
- Valve Index input problem solved. There is no need to use grab on Index, just trigger.
- On any device, you no longer need to grab to see the animation of the hand, just get close to the button.
I still like to grab it before use the trigger, but you can do whatever suits you more!
- Fixed glitch in Fuel and Weather wheel on Main Menu.
- Audio volume added: Master volume, to control the volume of all other volumes together.
- Better texture compression - increased performance!

notes.title: Update 1.0.6 - Cockpit Reflection
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

we are working to bring more missions and live scenario, but I decided to release this update with controls for window cockpit reflection!

As you asked, I added control from 0 to 100%, so you can choose the intensity of the reflection you want!

Open in-game menu to use it!

notes.title: Update 1.0.5! Interaction and textures!
notes.notes:
After all your weekend feedbacks and some improvements in our TODO list, we are releasing an update today with:

- Now you can lock your hand on the joystick. So there is no need to hold a grab on VR controller.
To do this, open in-game menu and choose "Lock Joystick on Grab" 
- Valve Index input problem solved. There is no need to use grab on Index, just trigger.
- On any device, you no longer need to grab to see the animation of the hand, just get close to the button.
I still like to grab it before use the trigger, but you can do whatever suits you more!
- Fixed glitch in Fuel and Weather wheel on Main Menu.
- Audio volume added: Master volume, to control the volume of all other volumes together.
- Better texture compression - increased performance! 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 - Expert controls and Analog Altimeter.
notes.notes:
First of all, Thanks for all your feedback!

BUG FIX:
- Analog Altimeter. Now it is working properly.
